releases.name: v6.5.4 - Final OpenCode v1 Release
releases.body: Final release for OpenCode v1 (v1.18.x). Includes terminal PowerShell quoting advisories, here-string preservation, filesystem batching enhancements, and marks OpenCode v2 as unsupported for now.

releases.name: v6.5.3 - OpenCode v1.18.32 Compatibility & Auto-Adaptation Engine
releases.body:
### Changes in v6.5.3

- **OpenCode v1.18.32 Compatibility**: Added exact host profile and verified fingerprints for upstream OpenCode v1.18.32.
- **Robust Auto-Adaptation Engine**: Implemented dynamic capability profile adaptation (\daptManifestForSource\) in the selfpatch pipeline to automatically adapt and preserve the Left Bar (Dock), customized TUI, and rich tool renderers across future OpenCode releases without version limitations.
- **Scoped Spec & Cache Fixes**: Added full recognition for scoped package specifications (e.g. \@mralony/opencode-optimised-toolings\) and enhanced cache cleanup.

## Self-healing deployment bootstrap

- Atomically repairs stale OpenCode @latest package caches from the attested canonical generation, including clean-machine startup.
- Adds exact OpenCode 1.18.19 and 1.18.21 compatibility profiles after byte-level host-boundary verification.
- Retries transient Windows source-promotion locks without masking structural failures.
- Reuses only cryptographically attested direct-local host artifacts during immutable candidate promotion.
- Preserves the one-declaration production model: Alonix in opencode.json, no Alonix entry in tui.json.

Validated locally through direct checkout and immutable candidate promotion before release.

releases.name: v6.5.1 - Current Runtime Authority
releases.body:
## Fixed

- Guarantees that the public \opencode-optimised-toolings@latest\ declaration executes the canonical attested immutable generation instead of OpenCode's stale mutable-tag package cache.
- Preserves one user-facing package declaration in \opencode.json\; the TUI export is bridged internally and no Alonix entry is written to \	ui.json\.
- Honors \OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR\ consistently in the TUI bridge.
- Preserves the public \@latest\ declaration across installed startup migration.
- Adds live stale-generation diagnostics without terminating unrelated OpenCode processes.
- Displays the actually loaded plugin version in Alonix Settings.

## Verification

- Immutable candidate validated after a full OpenCode restart.
- Root suite: 61 passed, 2 intentional environment-gated skips.
- TUI suite: 413 passed.
- Build, package allowlist, shareability, engine audit, runtime parity, and public-\@latest\ stale-cache regressions passed locally.

Publishing remains local-only from the exact annotated tag; no CI runner is used.
